messages:
alex: Heads-up — found a parity edge between the Node SDK and raw REST for the /generate endpoint. Sample app (starter-kit-node) gets intermittent 400s when sending a `metadata` object + custom headers. Repro below.

alex: Repro steps: 1) use node SDK v0.9.3, set metadata: { userPrefs: { mode: \"compact\" } } 2) attach header X-Client-Info: myapp/1.2.3 3) call client.generate(...) 4) sometimes get 400 with body 'invalid metadata serialization'

alex: Logs (SDK request payload):
```json
{
  \"prompt\": \"hello\",\n  \"metadata\": {\"userPrefs\": {\"mode\": \"compact\"}},\n  \"_internal\": {\"client\": \"node-sdk\"}\n}
```

alex: REST curl that works consistently:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -H 'X-Client-Info: myapp/1.2.3' \\
  -d '{"prompt":"hello","metadata":"{\"userPrefs\":{\"mode\":\"compact\"}}"}'
```

marta: Interesting — so REST expects metadata to be a JSON-stringified value but SDK sends an object? That seems like a historical quirk from the old v1 compat layer.

kevin: Yup. I remember an old change where we accepted both but then reverted to string for caching/kv reasons. SDK serialization stayed lax. That would explain intermittent 400s when gateway hits strict schema.

sam: Can you paste the gateway schema error? Was there a validator mention?

alex: Error from gateway: `schema_validation_failed: metadata must be string` — only shows up when request routes to strict validator nodes (weirdly, like 1/3 requests).

marta: Also saw an auth-related quirk in the sample app: SDK auto-refresh will try a refresh on 401 and resend without preserving some custom headers (X-Client-Info gets dropped). If REST client refresh logic kept headers it would be fine, but SDK's refresh path reconstructs request and forgets some headers. That combo could explain why sometimes REST works and SDK fails.

kevin: Oof. So two separate parity issues: (A) metadata must be stringified, (B) retry/refresh path drops ephemeral headers. Both together -> flaky 400s.

alex: Proposed immediate workaround for starter-kit: stringify metadata before passing to client and add guard to persist customHeaders on retries. Patch snippet for app: `const payload = {...}; payload.metadata = JSON.stringify(payload.metadata);`

sam: I'll pick this up. Plan: 1) add unit test that ensures sdk sends metadata as string 2) fix auth refresh path to copy over `options.customHeaders` 3) add e2e using gateway strict-validator flag.

marta: Can you open a GH issue and link the PR? Make sure to mark CI flaky tests if needed. Also add a migration note in CHANGELOG for v0.9.4 about metadata behavior.

sam: Created issue #4125 and draft PR at https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/789 — tests failing still but reproducer added.

alex: Nice. For ops: any chance we can relax strict validator temporarily? Ops might not want that. cc @ci-bot for deploy signals.

ci-bot: Deploy queued: patch/sdks/metadata-stringify to staging — build 2026.03.23.45. Will run integration tests against gateway-strict toggles.

kevin: After patch we should add telemetry to detect how often metadata arrives as object vs string so we can roll out safely.

marta: Agreed. Also update starter-kit docs: call out metadata must be string to avoid onboarding pain.

alex: Thanks team. Marking this high-priority for next patch release — affected a few new users onboarding this week.

sam: Will follow up with PR link in thread when green. :thumbsup:

kevin: Quick note: we should also audit Python SDK and REST wrappers for same auth-refresh-header bug.

alex: Thanks — closing loop when PR merged.
